# Exploración Datos {menu-title="Exploración Datos - Clasificacíon POIS"}

::: {.subtitle}
Clasificacíon Point Of Interest
:::


:::: {.clasificacion-main}

::: {.clasificacion-sub width="50%"}
::: {.dato-tipo}
Área baja accesibilidad
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| class: fig-class
from pathlib import Path
from scrips import clasificador_poi, grafico_categorias,poi_total_area, wheelchair_entrance_total,coverage_populartimes
import json

main_path = Path.cwd().resolve()
data_place_file = main_path / "Data" / "Area Baja" / "Data Places" / "01KTMJT07VW9.json"
data_populartimes_file = main_path / "Data" / "Area Baja" / "Data Populartimes" / "01KTMJT07VW9.json"

with open(data_place_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data_places = json.load(f)

with open(data_populartimes_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data_populartimes = json.load(f)

poly_id = list(data_places.keys())[0]

clasificador = clasificador_poi(data_places=data_places[poly_id])

fig = grafico_categorias(clasificador["cat_count"])
fig
```

::: {.area-poi-desc}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

n_pois = poi_total_area(data_places=data_places, poly_id=poly_id)
n_wheelchair = wheelchair_entrance_total(clasificador["cat_access"])
pop_coverage = coverage_populartimes(
    data_places=data_places,
    data_populartimes=data_populartimes,
    poly_id=poly_id
)

texto_area = f"""
<div class="area-poi-desc-box">
🏢 <b>POI identificados:</b> {n_pois}<br>
📈 <b>Cobertura PopularTimes:</b> {pop_coverage["Total PopularTimes"]} ({pop_coverage["Proporcion"]:.0f}%)<br>
♿ <b>Acceso silla de ruedas:</b> {n_wheelchair}
</div>
"""

print(texto_area)
```
:::
